children: Policymakers at Chile's central bank considered maintaining the rate unchained the "clearly dominant" option at its latest meeting in September as uncertainty remained higher than usual, the meeting minutes showed on Wednesday.
The bank's board unanimously decided to hold borrowing costs at 4.5% last week.
